title: Enforce asynchronous completion and release
runtime_identity: Linux 6.18.44 x86_64, 2 vCPU, Node v22.22.2, Chromium 1194; loopback only
decision_or_code_delta: gateway/ws.js: Leases released in write callbacks; cancellation/timeouts never release early; single exit.
expected: No buffer is reused before all consumers finish, and every admitted operation ends with exactly one ownership release or an explicit unrecoverable-abort report.
memory_scope: gateway process (+ worker threads) and worker processes
residual_risks: self-reviewed by the implementer; no independent verification
rollback: delete ram/, gateway/worker-link.js, worker/core.js, worker/thread.js; restore the v1 files from hermit-vws 1.1.0-vws.1 (hashes in ledger/ramws_source.json)
linked_tests: Lifetime: capacity returns only after the LAST consumer; duplicate release is counted, never refunded twice
[thread] vertical slice: hello(epoch) -> open -> opened before output -> binary input/output -> executed ack -> close -> single exit; ledger returns to zero
[process] vertical slice: hello(epoch) -> open -> opened before output -> binary input/output -> executed ack -> close -> single exit; ledger returns to zero
